notes: First-party PDF menus linked directly from the restaurant's own Squarespace site (saintjamesfrenchdiner.com), five separate PDFs: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Brunch, Rooftop. Address on the PDFs is 828 Sixth Avenue, San Diego, CA 92101 -- work list has 830 Sixth Ave, a 2-digit difference on the same block, same exact name/domain, treated as the same restaurant. The wine-by-the-glass/bottle list was excluded as a back-bar reference (dual GL/BT pricing, not a per-dish price) -- cocktails, coffee, and all food are included. Rooftop menu (bites + drinks) is a separate real menu, not an adjunct, and is included in full.

notes: Own site (emeraldchinesecuisineca.com, listed as 'Emerald Chinese Cuisine') embeds a qmenu.us ordering widget (iframe on /order/) which is a JS SPA -- curl of the iframe URL alone returns only the Angular shell, so the app's own main.js bundle was read to find its apiBaseUrl (an AWS API Gateway host) and the 'app/restaurants?alias=' REST endpoint, then queried directly for the full JSON menu (no browser needed). Address in the API response (3709 Convoy St Lecture Hall, San Diego, CA 92111) matches the work list exactly. 10 categories / 138 priced rows covering Appetizer, BBQ, Soup, Seafood, Chef's Special, Hot Pot, Stone Pot, Vegetable, Fried Rice & Noodle, and Dim Sum -- a complete first-party catalog, not a delivery-app subset. Markup test (divide by 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.20/1.25) found no clean signature (at most 6/138 land cleanly on any divisor), consistent with ordinary POS pricing, not an online-ordering surcharge. A few BBQ items (Roasted Duck, Crispy Fried Chicken, Empress Chicken) carry Half/Whole size options and are recorded as two rows each.

name: ARLO
notes: ARLO's own site (arlosandiego.com/menu/) embeds a SinglePlatform widget (tier 4 on the source ladder) rather than serving prices directly -- the widget iframe URL was reconstructed from the site's singleplatform-menu-compatibility script tag (data-location='arlo-4', data-api_key) and fetched directly as server-rendered HTML (no browser needed). Address in the widget's own embedded JSON (500 Hotel Circle North, San Diego, CA 92108) matches the work list exactly. The widget concatenates all 7 of the restaurant's nav tabs (Dinner, Cocktail and Beer, Dessert, Breakfast, Brunch, Mimosa Cart, Wine) into one server-rendered page in that order. Per SinglePlatform's playbook default this is 'medium' confidence (restaurant-submitted, no independent cross-check found) -- but price level throughout (contemporary dishes like Croffle, Ube French Toast, Japanese Milk Bread Cinnamon Roll; $9-$55 dinner mains) reads as current, not stale. Two adjuncts were deliberately excluded and are not in dishes[]: the full Bourbon/Whiskey/Rye/Scotch by-the-pour spirits list (~43 items, a back-bar liquor reference) and the standalone 'Wine by the Bottle' cellar list (~50 bottle-only wines beyond what's already covered by the by-the-glass pairs) -- both are reference lists, not a per-dish menu. A near-duplicate 'Beverage Wine' list embedded earlier under the Cocktail and Beer Menu tab and near-duplicate Beer/Coffee blocks repeated under the Breakfast/Mimosa Cart tabs were also skipped in favor of one canonical instance of each, to avoid inflating the dish count with the same item entered twice by the widget.
